_comment: A bare ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module: 16MB quad flash, 8MB octal PSRAM, no panel, no touch, no PMIC, no IMU, no codec. Probed 2026-09-19: ESP32-S3 rev v0.2, flash MXIC c2/2018 16MB, embedded PSRAM 8MB.
_console: This module is reached through its CH-series USB-UART bridge, not the native USB-Serial/JTAG port. The base target routes the console to USB-JTAG, which on this board logs into a port nobody is connected to.
_psram: N16R8 is 8MB OCTAL PSRAM (probed: AP generation-3, 64 Mbit, 3V). Declared rather than inherited — an octal setting on a quad-wired module boots wrong instead of failing.
_display: No panel and no canvas: this module has no display at all, so the runtime builds no framebuffer, no app tree and no frame loop. A bare module that wants an offscreen surface to screenshot over OTA declares a `canvas` block instead.
